records.title: Development of Airports in Tamil Nadu
details: d: An application for Site Clearance for the development of a greenfield airport at Hosur has been received in November, 2025, which is currently under consideration of this Ministry.

records.title: Expansion of Coimbatore Airport
details: a to c: The proposal for construction of New Integrated Terminal Building (T3) along with new apron bays at Coimbatore Airport is at a preliminary stage in Airports Authority of India.

records.title: Bypass Road On NH-85
details: a to b: Construction of the Bypasses will be undertaken based on the outcome of the DPR, inter-se priority, and synergy with PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan.

records.title: APMC Markets Integrated with e-NAM Platform
details: Part(a) & (b): As on 31.03.2024, 157 Agricultural Produce Market Committee (APMC) markets of Tamil Nadu have been integrated with National Agriculture Market (e-NAM) platform. 127 markets are yet to be integrated with e-NAM.

records.title: Construction of Bypass on NH-85
details: Detailed Project Report (DPR) consultant has been appointed for study of the stretch Madurai-Theni-Tamil Nadu/Kerela border in National Highway-85 (NH-85). The construction of bypass to the towns of Bodi, Theni, Aundipatti and Usilampatti on the new National Highway-85, which is part of this DPR, is subject to outcome of DPR, technical feasibility, inter-se priority and availability of funds.
